notes.title: Patch Notes #115 - New Crab City
notes.notes:
[p][b]New Crab City[/b]
The big city is here and better than ever! Take a stroll over to the market square, church, castle cates, stables or barracks to uncover new mobs, npcs, quests and much more! This zone was so much fun to make since it didn't really have much going on in the original! Adding new mobs and story to the zone helped bring it to life and make it feel like a true city. I hope you all enjoy it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/b9233e4a6ce2d16653aa51a13519b29b7466ba5d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Mounts[/b]
The time has come to climb upon your horse and ride into battle!!! Head over to the stables in the bottom left of NCC to get your hands on a horse today! Also... rumor has it there is a roaming mount dealer hiding somewhere just waiting to be found![/p][p]Quarter Horse, Arabian Horse and Friesian Horse all give you +20 movement speed. [/p][p]Pegasus gives you +35 movement speed but comes at a high cost.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/c1dead5dca2d2ef78f2559358380cb82d5274660.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]New Crab Guard Faction[/b]
The city streets run wild with creatures and enemies alike. It's your job to clean it up and reap the rewards! Speaking of faction rewards, the New Crab Guard introduces the first faction based Mount for hitting Venerated![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/8389e40381b405dfd360d96880c5ebb0f3ce6385.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]New Skills and Reckless Strike Rank 5[/b]
NCC introduces some new skills to add to your skillbook!

Rapid Fire - sacrifice Crit chance for faster Attack Speed and Attack Power.
Fragile Fury - sacrifice Armor for Attack Power.
Trade Off - sacrifice HP for Energy Regen.
Reckless Strike - an old skill getting a new rank! Dealing damage to the user while doing raw damage and Hate damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/626b2effc75a37a399a1642ff2b9c90c34edec27.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Hair? Check! Eyes? Check! Skin? Check![/b]
Looks like the Hairstylists and Surgeons have been hitting the books and learning new tricks just for you!

To the West, the hairstylist! She has lots of new designs and colors to choose from. Special thanks to Alyssa for all your work on the hair![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/02c9544f2b6494d1581a5d08663d740b70848e2d.png"][/img][/p][p]
To the East, the surgeons! They haven't had any patients since Noob Island so they took some time to head back to school and sharpen their skills! The Advanced Cosmetic Surgeon offers some crazy new body colors to choose from. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/86200f03af6b743bbdf8f863703209763e4f966d.png"][/img][/p][p]While the Advanced Neuroptic Surgeon has found a way to resize your eyes and recolor them with new colors![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/5dfe4358010de9046e6240a8cccee580d3320f78.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Second Hand Stan[/b]
Ever wanted to look like the icons of FO? Zutroy? The Collector? The Gemster? Well now you can! Second Hand Stan may have done some shady stuff to acquire these new outfit pieces but you don't need to know those details! Check his shop out in the market square in NCC![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/2a11ea020dc02b52756824d40b7c07099181a80e.png"][/img][/p][p]

[b]Lydia's Fight Line Shop[/b]
Head to the market square in NCC to get your hands on new Fight Lines! These new lines include Iron. Silver, Unobtainium, Coral, Salt and Soul![/p][p]What's a Fight Line? The Fight Line is the line that is drawn on the ground visually connecting you to the mob you're fighting. Buying one of the colors and equipping it will overwrite the standard red color Fight Line.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/e3f89f5aa4aa16b99d2a99e88e53b1caff576cf5.png"][/img][/p][p]

[b]Dr. Brewster's Bigger Brews[/b]
Dr. Brewster has been working hard in the lab and finally found a way to bottle all that Double Player XP, Faction XP and Battle Pass XP into bigger bottles! These pots give you double xp for 2 hours! Check him out in the market square in NCC.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/96930ea6a94f8c2173737ed9ee1042773bf0b9af.png"][/img][/p][p]

[b]Butterflies[/b]
Fluttering butterflies now surround the cherry blossom trees near the NCC castle gates! Another huge shout out to Alyssa! She brought this vibrant iconic area to life with her butterflies! Each one has a new color matching hair clip that drops at a 1/1000. Who will be the first to get all the colors?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/855eb9337f1f6adfd503de6d820f1cc6433686be.gif"][/img][/p][p]

[b]Boss Challenges[/b]
Take on old foes by claiming quests in NCC to kill multiple of one boss. These will reward you with unique outfits items and a ton of XP! These quest NPCs can be found all over NCC with each having a small story to them![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/5d90f2a05fc7eb12eee38c225ab6f15b61731d2a.png"][/img][/p][p]

[b]New Battle Pass[/b]
Introducing the Space Battle Pass! Get your hands on new unique outfits, crafting materials, faction badges, double xp, faction and bp potions, and much more! [/p][p]Special thanks to Moriarty for his hard work on this battle pass!

The Legacy Battle Pass and Summer Battle Pass will be leaving at this time and replaced with the Space Battle Pass and an updated version of the Fall Battle Pass (The Fall BP update will have the same cosmetics just updates to crafting materials, potions and faction items)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/2cb80abc64ba152519228cca0fc066314f2d979e.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]"Overequipping" Gear Overhaul[/b]
We've seen some suggestion posts recently talking about how "overequipping" gear feels a little off and unrewarding. There are just too many +# to ALL stat options and not enough diversity in how those stats are spread based on the set they come from. So we are making some stat changes to better "balance" these items. Below is a list of the changes.

[b]Scrap (FU Armor)[/b]
Legs - 600 Armor, +4 to all -> 600 Armor, 8 INT, 8 STA
Body - 800 Armor, +4 to all -> 800 Armor, 8 INT, 8 STA
Helm - 600 Armor, +4 to all -> 600 Armor, 8 INT, 8 STA
Face -  600 Armor, +3 to all -> 600 Armor, 6 INT, 6 STA

[b]Dark Alien (FUU Armor)[/b]
Legs - 700 Armor, +6 to all -> 700 Armor, -8 STA, +10 AGI, INT, and STR
Body - 700 Armor, +7 to all -> 800 Armor, -10 STA, +12 AGI, INT, and STR
Helm - 800 Armor, +6 to all -> 900 Armor, -6 STA, +8 AGI, INT, and STR
Face - 300 Armor, +4 to all -> 300 Armor, -4 STA, +4 AGI, INT, and STR

[b]Bearserker (Mirky Woods Armor)[/b]
Legs - 600 Armor, 14 STA, +10 AGI, INT, and STR -> 200 Armor, -10 INT, +10 AGI, +18 STA and STR
Body - 1000 Armor, 18 STA, +10 AGI, INT, and STR -> 300 Armor, -10 INT, +10 AGI, +22 STA and STR
Helm - 800 Armor, 16 STA, +10 AGI, INT, and STR -> 300 Armor, -10 INT, +10 AGI, +20 STA and STR
Face - 400 Armor, +10 to all -> 100 Armor, -10 INT, +10 AGI, +14 STA and STR

[b]Wooden (Dark Marsh Armor)[/b]
Legs - 5000 Armor, +18 to all -> 5000 Armor, +40 STA and AGI
Body - 6000 Armor, +22 to all -> 6000 Armor, +40 STA and STR
Helm - 7000 Armor, +25 to all -> 7000 Armor, +40 STA and INT
Face - 4000 Armor, +15 to all -> 4000 Armor, +20 STA, +10 AGI, INT and STR

[b]Naval Officer (Pirate Shores Hard Mode Armor)[/b]
Legs - +20 to all -> 3000 Armor, +50 AGI, +20 INT and STA, -20 STR
Body - +24 to all -> 4000 Armor, +50 STA, +30 AGI and STR, -25 INT
Helm - +27 to all -> 3500 Armor, +40 STR, +40 INT, +20 STA, -30 AGI
Face - +17 to all -> 2500 Armor, +25 AGI, INT, and STR, -15 STA
Shoulder - +15 to all -> 2000 Armor, +15 to all


[b]Summary[/b][/p][p]Wow! Lots of stuff! This was one of the greatest challenges I've had so far. Honoring such an iconic zone but also bringing new and interesting things to do in the area. As always, thank you all for playing this game and I hope you all enjoy this update! See you in the Haunted Forest soon![/p][p]-Dino

notes.notes:
[p]Starting in October all Patrons and upcoming Steam subscribers will receive an exclusive item every month! The higher the Gamer tier, the more exclusive items you will get.[/p][p]Gamer Tier - Exclusive Item x1[/p][p]Pro Gamer Tier - Exclusive Item x2[/p][p]Ultra Gamer Tier - Exclusive Item x4[/p][p]Triple Ultra Gamer Tier - Exclusive Item x12[/p][p]We are currently holding a Discord poll to determine what the October 2025 exclusive item will be. As of right now it's a very very tight race! Don't forget to vote here:
[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/channels/1076004705773310084/1307080602872188969/1413676000058806333"]https://discord.com/channels/1076004705773310084/1307080602872188969/1413676000058806333[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/1f14639f74678691d5dca9619d580a19314e0364.png"][/img][/p][h2]Steam subscription options coming soon![/h2][p][/p][p]And now, on with the patch notes![/p][p][/p][p]A lot of people are now playing exclusively on mobile, so I decided to move about half of the chat rewrite work up in the schedule to right now![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/7843278690bd13302a90f52eafd0b25d3dd6831c.png"][/img][/p][p]Here's what Chat v1.5 looks like. There's a lot going on here, so let's go over all the features.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/f683df137393a37478e0a4fe82290ea2e8a238bf.png"][/img][/p][p]The top left arrow can be used to shrink and grow the chat window.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/d12c848209c8915dae9d75ba89dad19094972b50.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/ada006a6eb5081559caa9708921313ac556dea30.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/a2060f8a1929af3c20c0458f2f172330f1b15cb3.png"][/img][/p][p]When chat is minimized and you receive a whisper, a guild message, or a party message, the chat box will highlight to show there's a new message for you to view.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/07739da4450c2a2475999aec68ea1d8bdb1c3a75.png"][/img][/p][p]There are now chat tabs that are dedicated to whisper, guild, and party chat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/5391b7393210c93e623999bc4fd2385dd3228534.png"][/img][/p][p]On the guild and party tabs, you don't have to use /g or /p to chat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/e4c5cca0ea0376c392f8777311f2f3067bd9baee.png"][/img][/p][p]All chat tabs can now be paused to slow down scrolling when new messages come in.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/26276c2ac12774e6041374d49e820860e9fa2213.png"][/img][/p][p]The friends and ignores pop up window has been moved and now pops out of the bottom right of the chat message input box.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/2ae943cffdb4f72d2687e31be7957ce7258fed6e.png"][/img][/p][p]The chat text input box now accepts multiline input that wraps around.[/p][p]And that's Chat v1.5 in all it's glory! Now on to all the other stuff I've been working on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/1ccf445834f1b8d02d7c7f1c61755b3783a4269f.png"][/img][/p][p]We've got our first implant in the game as we get ready to release Ascension in October![/p][p][/p][p][b]Gamer's Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]MySQL databases updated to v8.4.4[/p][/*][*][p]SmartfoxServer updated to v2.20.3 which includes Tomcat 9.0.105, with several bug and security fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed GUIFont bitmap font code to work with negative left bearings and to deal better with single character strings.[/p][/*][*][p]Separated out friends list into it's own file and cleaned it up a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]Started work on new chat![/p][/*][*][p]Added multiline text input to chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added emoji picker to chat. (BabylonJS text input can't handle emojis so this will come in the future)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new top right mobile buttons that are smaller.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed insets on mobile.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved over friends/ignores to new chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added send button to mobile on new chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Ported over 90% of the code from old chat to new chat.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now click a name in your friends list to start a whisper to them.[/p][/*][*][p]Setup Java Flight Recorder continuous recording to analyze performance bottlenecks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added expaning and shrinking to the chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat is now shown by default on mobile.[/p][/*][*][p]Added iPad support for iOS builds! Update to latest in TestFlight![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some friends/ignores bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a chat bug where text would overlap.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a chat bug where messages would render in the wrong order.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the population of the quest log on login.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now mouse over and click chat messages to start whispers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a highlight bug with GUIToggle.[/p][/*][*][p]Added whisper tips to whisper tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Added guild chat tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Added party chat tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Added server and client code for the process of ascension.[/p][/*][*][p]Start process of porting to [b]*[i]redacted[/i]*[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Signed docs with [b]*[i]redacted[/i]* [/b]for f2p launch next year.[/p][/*][*][p]When chat is shrunk and you receive party, guild, or whisper chat then the border of the chat box changes to alert you.[/p][/*][*][p]Shrinking chat will change tab to ALL automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]You don't need /g on the guild tab or /p on the party tab anymore![/p][/*][*][p]Chat play/pause is in![/p][/*][*][p]Implants data has been added to characters server side.[/p][/*][*][p]Added brain, heart, left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg implant slots on client and server.[/p][/*][*][p]Added debug code that actually captures the game video directly in the game. Recorded at 720p, upscaled to 4k, and now on YouTube. Here's a test: [/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=82zHSk9YjNI"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p]Brain slot is now functional and visible in the implants tab.[/p][/*][/list][p]And would you believe that Dino has been busier than me? Believe it. You won't believe how much stuff he's added until you get to NCC on September 23rd.[/p][p][b]New Crab City[/b]
New adventures, quests, items, outfits, mounts, secrets and much more await you in the city!
You will be able to walk in from Dark Marsh so make sure you hit level 76 so you can enter NCC![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/d9c2288f1627953ca118d8c3a1480b49cd6e0291.png"][/img][/p][p]

notes.title: Patch Notes #112 - Pirate Shores Dungeons
notes.notes:
[p][b]Pirate Shores[/b]
The black flag flies once more over the horizon. Undead Blackbeard and his crew have clawed their way back from the abyss to claim the seas as their own. Board your ship, ready your blades, and take back the Pirate Shores![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/354b231178ace63df607850054db46a627a999a5.png"][/img]

[b]What to expect![/b]
- Fight your way through Blackbeard's crew to get your hands on new weapons, armor, rings, trinket and outfits!
- Easy Level Dungeons, level 30 requirement, will create a slight challenge by increasing the HP and damage for level 30 range mobs.
- Medium Level Dungeons, level 60 requirement, a tougher challenge introducing Debuffs while having increased HP and damage for level 60 range mobs.
- Hard Level Dungeons, level 90 requirement, turn the dial up even higher and bring about Aggro, additional Debuffs, increased HP and damage for level 90 range mobs.
- All difficulties have different items to obtain. So make sure, even if you're max level, to do the level 30 and 60 dungeons to collect everything![/p][p]- You'll need to be in a party to enter the Dungeon. Minimum of two players.
- Loot is a little rarer than normal zones! So keep grinding to get your hands on some booty![/p][p]- Mobs and Bosses do not respawn. Once you've wiped the shores of pirates and turned in your daily quests you can teleport out using the NPC on the beach near spawn.

[b]Relics[/b]
Relics are a new item type coming with the Pirate Shores dungeon and other dungeons in the future. You'll have a chance at obtaining the Pirate's Flag, Captain's Log and Blackbeard's Spyglass from Undead Blackbeard!

[b]Enhanced Spyglass[/b]
Enhanced? Yes! Obtain the base version of Blackbeard's Spyglass and a new rare resource called Cursed Doubloons to focus your Spyglass into specific stat types. The 3 enhanced versions all give strength bonuses while gaining additional stats based on how you focus the Spyglass.

[b]Cooldown Timer Info and FAQ[/b]
- You can do one attempt per day of per difficulty.
- Dungeon cooldowns reset at the normal daily reset time.
- The cooldown activates when you enter the zone so don't teleport out!
- While in a party, if you disconnect and the other party members are still in the dungeon you will rejoin upon logging back in.
- If all party members leave the zone or log out the zone will close.

Q: My party is still in the dungeon and I teleported to a different zone. Can I rejoin them using the Dungeon Ready Up Window?
A: No, you are locked out from rejoining.

Q: I went in with a party but then they left so I could do the dungeon solo. If I disconnect or teleport to a new zone, does the dungeon close?
A: Yes and you'll need to wait for the next daily reset to enter the same difficulty dungeon.

Q: My team and I are in the dungeon and I disconnect but they don't. They are still in the zone, can I rejoin?
A: Yes, as long as a party member is still in the zone when you log back in you'll be with them.

Q: If someone relogs are they still considered part of the party? Normally it kicks you out once you dc.
A: Yes and no. They will join your instance but will need an invite back to be part of the party again.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/be58532f6f332ff04fd73fd46f62ad535151dca6.png"][/img][/p][p]

With the release of pets comes the release of a new original zone to Fantasy Online 2, Whispering Wilds!

While in the Whispering Wilds you'll help pet trainers get back their stolen pet food, collect special drops for pet fanatics and most importantly, collect Pet Eggs to unlock pets and enhance your gameplay and builds!

That's not the only place you can get pets! Mobs around all zones will have pets added to them. A list on release day will be provided to help you on your hunt!

[b][u]Normal, Mega and Uber Pets in Whispering Wilds[/u][/b]
The 4 core pets that you can obtain in Whispering Wilds are the Wyvern, Owl, Urshound and Wolf! These 4 pets will be spawning in the wilds in all their forms! Spawning? Forms? That's right! You'll need to fight these pets as mobs to have a chance at their pet egg drop. The forms are the varying levels of these 4 specific pets. Normal pets are level 30, Mega pets are level 60 and Uber pets are level 90!

[b][u]Normal vs Uber Pets from everywhere else[/u][/b]
Unlike the 4 special pets in Whispering Wilds these pets have two variations, Normal or Uber. Normal pets are pretty self-explanatory but Uber pets are the better versions of these pets. They will have small increases to the bonuses they give you along with unique color palettes making them stand out from the normals!

notes.title: Patch Notes #105 - Dark Marsh
notes.notes:
[b][u]Dark Marsh[/u][/b]
The day is finally here! If you're reading this, Dark Marsh is here and ready for you to explore! New mobs, items, skills, crafts, bags (trunks), morphs, and more can be found in the marshlands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/7cfbf6deed50144ddce7941f91597dd9717f08e8.png[/img]

[b][u]Dark Marsh Bosses[/u][/b]
Both will have a solo challenge this time round! Take on The Father or Mother Nature solo with proof of the completion via screen recordings or alerting a mod, Dark, Alyssa, Destaith or Dino of your attempt so they can witness the fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/f293b01d0b0bbcd8e620633718ecab217e490d8d.png[/img]

[b][u]Wood Cutting and Mahogany Trunks[/u][/b]
When trunks? NOW! Mahogany Trunks have been added to Dark Marsh! However, to obtain the best bags, trunk, in the game you'll need to learn a new ability. Wood Cutting! You can cut down Mahogany Saplings with a Saw. How do you get a Saw? Head over to the Loggers Camp and help him with his Centaur problem. Also, he may have some more tasks for you to get a Chainsaw?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/5f85b04fd7ca87e9bb90f257bd187750cca186ca.png[/img]

[b][u]Forest Keepers and Lumber Lords[/u][/b]
Two new factions have come to Fantasy Online 2 with the addition of Dark Marsh. Each come with new factions outfits, medallions, banners and crests!

Want to increase your faction rank? Take on mobs like Frogs, Gnomes, Dryads and Werebears, to increase your Forest Keepers rank and Mahogany Saplings, Centaurs, Forces of Nature and Mother Nature to increase your Lumber Lords rank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/706578184568a327051495ceed80331010773068.png[/img]

[b][u]Metamorph Rank 2 and Rework[/u][/b]
Rank 2 Metamorphs are here and some of you got a preview of those earlier today! Head to Dark Marsh and take on the Elemental Fairies. Each one will drop unique crystals needed to upgrade the Rank 1 Skill Books.

In the process of adding Rank 2 Metamorphs we took a good look at the sprites. The morph sprites we currently have in game were from the original with minor touch ups to match the style of FO2 better but still had something off about them. Thanks to Alyssa's hard work we now have updated versions to fit the feel of FO2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/80a30c3a713785ccf1ddb1f703a8512f1157af79.png[/img]

[b][u]Debuffs[/u][/b]
Coming with Dark Marsh the elemental Fairies will have different debuffs based on their element. Also, Mother Nature and Forces of Nature will have Root so get ready to stand there while praying your dodge doesn't fail you.

- Fire will have Burn. While Burn is active you will take continuous damage even while out of combat.
- Earth will have Thin Skin. While Thin Skin is active your Armor will be reduced.
- Wind will have Off Target. While Off Target is active your Crit will be reduced.
- Ice will have Degen. While Degen is active your Energy will deplete even while outside of combat.

Debuffs will have a cast interval and a success percent.
Example: Cast Interval is 30 seconds. Success Percent is 50%.
If it's successful then the debuff duration timer will start. When finished the mob can cast again.
If the debuff is unsuccessful, the 30 second interval timer starts again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/a49aa5841b4b94f2e7ef108481f30179762d4a8d.png[/img]

[b][u]Tier Set Bonuses[/u][/b]
Tier set bonuses are here! Get rewarded for using multiple of the same tier set gear. This includes armor, weapon, books and rings. Think of set bonuses as having an additional Tier Book that just gets applied behind the scenes. Below is a table showing off the bonuses for all tier sets along with a sneak peek at T5 bonuses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/5637b1cb9f1189448096539e30a77ed293aa3cd7.png[/img]

[b][u]Gold Pickaxe Crafting[/u][/b]
You will now be able to craft a Gold Pickaxe as you enter the Forgotten Underground. Now go collect some RF Gold Plates and Gold Crab Relics and get to mining!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/c7e7c8a313f7f04ca0accec46d25c69001f75528.png[/img]

[b][u]Gemstones, Salt, Coral and Souls[/u][/b]
We've heard the talks on gemstone drop rates for quite some months now and understand a buff should be made. Alongside gemstones, there’s been talk of other valuable resources like salt, coral, souls, and even pearls from clams.

-   Onyx, Sapphires, Amethysts, Rubies and Diamonds will be receiving a buff from 5% drop change to 10%.
-   Diamonds were the odd one out with a 7.5% drop rate but will also be made 10%  .
-   Pearls from Clams and Big Clams will also receive a buff. Clams will go from 2.5% to 5% and Big Clams 5% to 10%.  
-   Salt Veins will now have a 3% chance to drop a Salt Slab.  
-   Coral Veins will now have a 3% chance to drop a Coral Slab.  
-   Graves will now have a 1% chance to drop a Soul Gem.  
-   Tombstones will now have a 2% chance to drop a Soul Gem.  

[b][u]Feedback on Discord[/u][/b]
As always, I appreciate everyone's feedback and love for the game. I read all the messages in the main discord and the direct messages, even if I don't reply. That being said, please keep feedback constructive without going after people for their opinion.
- Dino

notes.title: Patch Notes #103 - Spatial Skill Sound Effects & Fight Line Colors
notes.notes:
All damage skill sound effects are played using spatial audio! "Spatial audio" refers to sounds placed in a three dimensional space. It requires a "listener" to hear the audio, and a "source" to emit the audio. Listeners and sources both have a 3D position and direction, and sources have additional settings for specifying how the sound should propagate in the 3D space.

In FO2 the listener position is set to your characters position and the source position is set to the damage target's position. The source also is set to currently be at default volume from 1-64 pixels from the target, falls off from 64-512 pixels, and is silent past 512 pixels. This will possibly be changed to use the viewport size in the future.

All damage skills now have visual effects and sound effects that play on the target. We continue to work on finding and commissioning more visual effects and sound effects to cover other skill types like buffs, healing, and teleports.

notes.title: Patch Notes #85 - Frozen North + Rebirth
notes.notes:
[h3]Frozen North and Rebirth[/h3]
The freezing land of Frozen North has blown its way into FO2! Along with a new zone comes lots of new loot to discover, mobs and bosses to slay, secrets, and quests! Enjoy the notes below for sneak at other features coming in this patch. - Dino

[h3]Rebirth[/h3]
What is Rebirth? Rebirth is a new leveling mechanic that can be done in Frozen North once you've hit level 60. Find Frozen Death in the main town and get ready to experience the game all over again. Complete quests, level up and play the game from the beginning but this time with additional rewards! Every 4 levels you'll get a bonus stat point and the ability to level past 60! Other rewards for Rebirthing are currently in production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/a4a49c5c6a9f98f5e1cd3bb3cee16a56fc3bf173.png[/img]

[h3]Back Items and Elite Bosses[/h3]
With this update we're introducing some pretty tough bosses with great rewards, the first back armor items!!! Get out there and slay these bosses as quickly as you can to be immortalized in FO2 history!

notes.title: Patch Notes #84 - The Craftening
notes.notes:
THE CRAFTENING
Hey again everyone! Dino here with another huge content update! We all know you're super excited about Rebirth and Frozen North! Don't worry, that's coming soon! Before we can get to Rebirth and FN why don't we give you all a little more power? With today's patch we're introducing a lot and I really do mean A LOT of crafting. So much crafting I have dubbed this update The Craftening! Let's dive into what you can find with the newest patch.

EMERALD CRAFTING
Time to start those crafts for obtaining your Tier 3 gear! Head to Forgotten Under Underground and find Sigurd and the Emerald Crafter. They'll help you craft those emeralds into high tier emeralds and Starforged gear.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/3d8e1e5de61f3ed869ef24a85a22f7a0e1ca109c.png[/img]


TIER 3 ARMOR
Tier 3 armor has also made its way to the Forgotten Under Underground. Get those tier 2 sets ready for an upgrade and harness the power of the ancients. Wait, are those shoulder items?! Yes, they are! You can find the new Ancient Shoulder Blueprint being sold by the shopkeep in FUU.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/7795b5cbf0bb1616cd70959d5cb0157d1287208f.png[/img]


TIER 3 WEAPONS
What is a cool new armor set without a new weapon to destroy things with? To craft these beauties you'll need to head to Mirky Woods. The weaponsmith will be hanging around the elf camp ready to upgrade those tier weapons to their next level!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/3e03045c3149d32a8c972be05fdea037729068b9.png[/img]

CELESTIAL GEM CRAFTING
You may have noticed that your Tier 3 armor has a new edition! Tier 3 comes with brand new tier shoulder items. However, they require mega and uber celestials?!? Not to worry, head to Mirky Woods and make your way to the Badger camp to find a wise old Badger. He has the knowhow to merge the unknown power of your celestial gems into higher rarities.

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/963d16a41a0de4e3666184dcdd7a57c21c7953ad.png[/img]


TIER 2 BOOKS AND RINGS
If the armor, weapons and gem crafting wasn't enough then I have one more trick up my sleeve. Tier 2 Books and Rings has also come to Forgotten Under Underground. These crafters are a little farther down into the cave but will be ready to upgrade those Tier 1 Books and Rings into something stronger and hopefully take your build to the next level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057662/b047703b1722df6a3dfbc06aff9dadb57f90f169.png[/img]

EVENT REMINDERS

Holiday Isle and the Christmas 2024 Event leave January 29th! Your Holiday Isle Teleport skill will just teleport you to Mirabella Cove until the event returns. You will not need to buy the Key for Gems again!


MORE?!?!
Of course there's mo... wait.. that's actually it! I got a little carried away with this update but of course wouldn't have been able to do it without some help. Shout out to Moriarty for his hard work remaking some classics with the tier armor and Dark for his help keeping me on track lol. In the next big patch coming from me we'll open the gates to Frozen North and the ability to REBIRTH! See you all next time. -Dino
